#import file

```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

#Put in file names
OLD_1.5h <- read_excel("11.23_Cipro_BZB_TECANtest_OLD.xlsx", sheet="first")
OLD_15h <- read_excel("11.23_Cipro_BZB_TECANtest_OLD.xlsx", sheet="second") 
OLD_ref <- read_excel("11.23_Cipro_BZB_TECANtest_OLD.xlsx", sheet="keys")
#Old

NEW_1.5h <- read_excel("11.23_Cipro_BZB_TECANtest_NEW.xlsx", sheet="first")
NEW_15h <- read_excel("11.23_Cipro_BZB_TECANtest_NEW.xlsx", sheet="second") 
NEW_ref <- read_excel("11.23_Cipro_BZB_TECANtest_NEW.xlsx", sheet="keys")
```

#NEW TECAN

```{r}
NEW_1.5h$"Cycle" <- as.numeric(NEW_1.5h$"Cycle")
NEW_15h$"Cycle" <- as.numeric(NEW_15h$"Cycle")

NEW_15h$"Cycle" <- NEW_15h$"Cycle" + 90

NEW_15h$"Time_s" <- NEW_15h$"Time_s" + 5400

combined_NEW <- bind_rows(NEW_1.5h, NEW_15h)

#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD_NEW <- combined_NEW %>%
pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")

#change Time [s] to Time [h]
df_clean_NEW <- pivoted_OD_NEW%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(Time_s/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  select(Cycle, Time_h, Time_min, everything())

#add a key col
df_clean_NEW<- left_join(df_clean_NEW, NEW_ref[, c("well_ID", "key", "cipro_ug_mL", "trial", "trial_rep", "trial_ID")], by = "well_ID")

df_clean_NEW$cipro_ug_mL<-factor(as.numeric(df_clean_NEW$cipro_ug_mL))

```

#OLD TECAN

```{r}
OLD_1.5h$"Time_s" <- str_remove(OLD_1.5h$"Time_s", "s")
OLD_15h$"Time_s" <- str_remove(OLD_15h$"Time_s", "s")

OLD_1.5h$"Time_s" <- as.numeric(OLD_1.5h$"Time_s")
OLD_15h$"Time_s" <- as.numeric(OLD_15h$"Time_s")

OLD_15h$"Time_s" <- OLD_15h$"Time_s" + 5460

combined_OLD <- bind_rows(OLD_1.5h, OLD_15h)

#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD_OLD <- combined_OLD %>%
pivot_longer(cols = -c(1), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")

#change Time [s] to Time [h]
df_clean_OLD <- pivoted_OD_OLD%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(Time_s/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  select(Time_h, Time_min, everything())

#add a key col
df_clean_OLD<- left_join(df_clean_OLD, OLD_ref[, c("well_ID", "key", "cipro_ug_mL", "trial", "trial_rep", "trial_ID")], by = "well_ID")

df_clean_OLD$cipro_ug_mL<-factor(as.numeric(df_clean_OLD$cipro_ug_mL))
```

#calculate mean from replicates

```{r}
NEW_summarise <- df_clean_NEW %>%
  filter(trial != "test") %>%
  group_by(Time_h, trial, cipro_ug_mL) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    CV = sd/mean,
    log_mean = log10(mean),
    lower_error = log10(mean) - log10(mean - sd),
    upper_error = log10(mean + sd) - log10(mean))

```

```{r}
OLD_summarise <- df_clean_OLD %>%
  filter(trial != "test") %>%
  group_by(Time_h, trial, cipro_ug_mL) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    CV = sd/mean,
    log_mean = log10(mean),
    lower_error = log10(mean) - log10(mean - sd),
    upper_error = log10(mean + sd) - log10(mean))
```

#plot curves

##curves of mean OD

```{r}
NEW_freshCipro<- NEW_summarise |>
  filter(trial == "F") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = cipro_ug_mL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-sd, ymax = mean+sd, color = cipro_ug_mL), width = 0.2)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve, New TECAN Trial",
        subtitle = "Initial CFU ~ 5*10^5/mL per well; Using freshly made Cipro Stock",
        y="Mean OD",
        caption = str_wrap("Cipro conc. is diluted by 1.5-fold; Growth control: cipro conc.= 0; MHB-only blank: cipro conc.= NA", width = 35))

NEW_freshCipro

#set working directory before saving!
ggsave("./plots_ggsave/Cipro_BZB_NewTECAN_freshCipro_112326.png", plot = NEW_freshCipro, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

##NEW & OLD TECAN comparison

```{r}
TECANcompare<- inner_join(
  NEW_summarise[,c("Time_h", "trial", "cipro_ug_mL", "mean")],
  OLD_summarise[,c("Time_h", "trial", "cipro_ug_mL", "mean")],
  by= c("Time_h", "trial", "cipro_ug_mL"),
  suffix = c(".NewT", ".OldT"))

TECANcompare <- TECANcompare|>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2,3), names_to = "TECAN", values_to = "meanOD")
```

```{r}
TECANcompare_curve<- TECANcompare |>
 filter(trial == "F") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = meanOD, color = TECAN)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
 facet_wrap(~cipro_ug_mL)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve, by Cipro Concentration",
        subtitle = "Initial CFU ~ 5*10^5/mL per well; Using freshly made Cipro Stock",
        y="Mean OD",
        color="Tecan Model",
        caption = str_wrap("Cipro conc. is diluted by 1.5-fold; Growth control: cipro conc.= 0; MHB-only blank: cipro conc.= NA", width = 35))

TECANcompare_curve

#set working directory before saving!
ggsave("./plots_ggsave/Cipro_BZB_TECANcompare_freshCipro_112326.png", plot = TECANcompare_curve, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
